name: Potato Cracker
ingredients_raw: Potato Flakes (26%), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palmolein Oil) (22%), Tapioca Starch (17.6%), Maize Starch (17.6%), Wheat Flour (10%), Potato Starch, iodised Salt, Mixed Spices (Onion, Coriander, Cumin, Garlic, Dry Mango, Chilli, Spice Extracts, Pepper, Ginger, Fenugreek), Sugar, Maltodextrin, Acidity Regulators [INS 330 & INS 450 (i)], Raising Agent [INS 500 (ii).
